caption: The drawing features a detailed, monochromatic depiction of a large tankard with a domed lid and an ornate, scrolling handle, rendered in shades of gray. The tankard is centered on the page, occupying most of the composition, with smooth, softly shaded surfaces that suggest a metallic material. Surrounding the main image are four smaller sketches, each contained within its own square border: at the top left is a circular, decorative monogram; at the top right is a detail view of the top of the handle with vertical grooves and a knob; at the bottom left is a scalloped-edge pattern; and at the bottom right is a side profile of the tankard with measurements indicated. The background is a uniform light beige, and the objects are outlined with fine, precise lines.
title: Silver Tankard
